title: Microsoft Defender Event Hub field schema catalogue
scope: All 23 requested dataset labels. XDR field dictionaries were extracted from public table references; Defender for Cloud schemas use published export schemas where available, otherwise explicitly labelled REST references.
notes: This is a field catalogue, not a strict JSON Schema validator.
Null requiredness means unspecified; allow additional fields.
Defender for Cloud continuous export and Defender XDR streaming use different formats.
SecurityRecommendations and SecurityAssessments are aliases of the Assessments export source.
Field names and types preserve public documentation; confirm tenant-specific GA availability using getschema and captured messages.
Use the per-dataset export schema; no shared records[]/properties wrapper is asserted.
IsSnapshot identifies snapshot exports according to continuous export documentation; its placement must be verified in messages.
